cohort: Mothers and their children under five years old in 7 Asian (South Asia-ASEAN) developing countries (Indonesia, Myanmar, Cambodia, Philippines, Bangladesh, Nepal, and Pakistan).
finding: Lack of antenatal care and low birth weight were significant predictors of under-five mortality.
country: Indonesia, Myanmar, Cambodia, Philippines, Bangladesh, Nepal, and Pakistan
followup_time: Up to five years after birth
birth_weight: Low birth weight infants were included in the study.
